nodes.label: Concern A - Stock Check (Golden Index Job)
nodes.rationale: Stock value -> KAN -> identify rest for stock check; assembly packs and Sesame PNs are irrelevant here and must stay strictly separate from matching.

nodes.label: KAN-grain Golden Index
nodes.rationale: Authoritative index becomes KAN-grain - one KAN to one vendor stock number (plus packs/Sesame PNs for Concern B) - because identity is the KAN, not the part.

nodes.label: Separate Concerns (A vs B)
nodes.rationale: Stock check (Concern A) and Sesame/Asana task update (Concern B) are different jobs; mixing them is what made the old index wrong.
